description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Amazing Home! * Private, Fenced in Pool (Heated for Add'l $40/nt)* 4 Bikes Included* 2 Full Kitchens and Living Rooms* Outdoor Shower and Rinsing Area!* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Under 1 Mile to Seaside’s Central Square* Nearby Surfing Deer, Café 30A and Dough Sea Dough Donuts!* Professionally Managed; 24/7 service.*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!*The private pool can be heated for an additional fee***Construction on the beach access is occurring and will be completed by April 30, 2025. During this time, the One Seagrove beach access will be closed, including over Spring Break. For your convenience, the nearest public beach accesses are Bramble Grove, 1 mile west, and Eastern Lake, 1 mile east.**Welcome to your stunning 30A beach home! Double Down features 4 bedrooms, 4 baths and sleeps up to 10 guests comfortably. This gorgeous home is a converted duplex with two 2BR/2BA units. A living room door allows easy access between each unit. The main level is up a flight of stairs and features both living areas and kitchens. The second level has two king master bedrooms, each with balcony access, and two guest rooms, each with a twin over full bunk plus twin trundle. All bedrooms and both living rooms have large flat screen TVs! You don’t want to miss this incredible vacation spot just off Hwy 30A. Come have the time of your life at Double Down!The Bed SetupSecond LevelMaster Bedroom: King BedMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk + Twin TrundleGuest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk + Twin Trundle Area Attractions:Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
